logic.name: Logic: Conditions Become Events
logic.truth: A condition is encountered through what a construction lets happen.
logic.description: Four short rooms reuse the event chain, supported gravity gates and hand-built pallet workshop.
logic.qfep_connection: Separate intended truth tables from observed material outcomes.
learning_objectives: Trace an event through physical contacts

Arrange parts by hand and save a reusable loose collection
